from timm.loss import LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy

import pandas as pd

from tqdm import tqdm

# Config

# Load metadata
with open("input/nybg2020/train/metadata.json") as f:
    train_meta = json.load(f)

# Create dataframe
df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "image_id": [img["id"] for img in train_meta["images"]],
        "file_name": [
            f"input/nybg2020/train/images/{img['file_name']}"
            for img in train_meta["images"]
        ],
        "category_id": [ann["category_id"] for ann in train_meta["annotations"]],
    }
)

# Stratified train-val split
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(
    df, test_size=0.2, stratify=df["category_id"], random_state=42
)


# Dataset with augmentations
class HerbariumDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, size=256, train=True):
        self.df = df
        self.train = train
        self.size = size

        self.base_tfm = T.Compose(
            [
                T.Resize(size),
                T.ToTensor(),
                T.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
            ]
        )

        if self.train:
            self.aug = T.Compose(
                [
                    T.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                    T.RandomVerticalFlip(),
                    T.RandomRotation(30),
                    rand_augment_transform(
                        config_str="rand-m9-mstd0.5", hparams={"img_size": size}
                    ),
                ]
